detail: Full summary: docs/UPGRADE-v2.md beta enrollment instructions tell testers to create .mcp.json with bare `npx` command — any tester in a GUI-launched or minimal-PATH environment (cmux teams, some IDE launches) hits the same silent failure. Docs should recommend the sh -lc wrapper (with a Windows caveat: sh -lc is not portable to Windows; Windows testers should use `cmd /c npx` or an absolute path).
